scale.0: Behavior misses or contradicts the requirement.
scale.1: Partially useful but has a material gap.
scale.2: Meets the behavior with appropriate flexibility.
scale.unscored: No reviewer judgment yet; do not convert to zero or treat as passing.

review_protocol: Blind reviewers to checkpoint/training labels and randomize arm order. Read the whole fixed conversation before rating the response.
Score only dimensions listed for that case. Cite a short response span or precise missing behavior and add a note. Do not use exact-string reference-answer matching for pedagogy.

An empty final response earns 0 on relevant behavioral dimensions only after a reviewer confirms it is empty; transport failures remain missing outputs. A valid tool-call-only response may satisfy a tool case without prose.

Review the complete generated activity, including keys and explanations; compilation is not correctness. Rendered answer-key storage in an activity is expected and differs from revealing answers in surrounding prose before an attempt.
No optional model judge is included in the frozen baseline. If added later, report its prompt/model/version/cost and calibration against human review separately.

For each dimension report sum / (2 × number of rated cases), rated count, and missing count. Report category-level automatic contract pass rates separately; do not combine them into one teaching score.
Paired comparisons use identical cases, system prompt, tools, sampling parameters, and output caps; exclude neither silent failures nor difficult cases after seeing results.

Use this public development suite to guide iteration and compare models consistently. Repeated tuning makes it a known target; evaluate separate fresh held-out conversations before generalization or promotion claims.
limitations: This is an authored static next-turn benchmark, not a validated measure of human learning, long-term retention, or production reliability.
The rubric has not been calibrated for inter-rater agreement. Report reviewer coverage and disagreements rather than treating subjective scores as established truth.
A fixed prior conversation holds context constant, but does not measure full interactive recovery from a candidate’s own earlier mistakes.
Category and core-subset weights are design choices, not a representation of measured production traffic. No overall superiority or sample-efficiency claim follows from this suite alone.
version_policy: Frozen v1 review dimensions and case-specific anchors. Scoring changes require a newly identified benchmark version; retain earlier definitions and results.
